description: This file defines an abstract class Smarty_CacheResource_Custom for handling custom cache resources in Smarty templating engine. It provides methods for fetching, saving, deleting, and managing cached content and metadata.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Custom
classes.description: An abstract class providing an API for custom cache resource handling within Smarty, including fetching, saving, deleting, and populating cache metadata.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Abstract method to fetch cached content and its modification time from data source.

methods.name: fetchTimestamp
methods.description: Fetch cached content's modification timestamp; can be overridden for performance.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Abstract method to save content to cache.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Abstract method to delete cached content.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populate cached object with metadata from resource.

methods.name: populateTimestamp
methods.description: Populate cached object with timestamp and existence info.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Read the cached template, process header, and evaluate content.

methods.name: readCachedContent
methods.description: Read cached template content from cache.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Empty cache for a specific template/resource.

methods.name: hasLock
methods.description: Check if cache is locked for a template.
